method.generator: Mulberry32; SHA-256 seed; exact rejection-sampled integer choices
method.pMeaning: Probability of ATTEMPTING a target-linked answer, not final inclusion. At p=1 only 3 of 5 linked electives can be selected; this is not a perfect profile.

rules.electives: Independent linked Bernoulli attempts, uniform trim to 3, uniform number of additions 0..remaining capacity from remaining rows
rules.core: Include linked core with p then 0..2 other cores; otherwise 1..3 distinct of the OTHER three
rules.oldSubjects: Independent p attempts for two links; if zero choose 1..3 of all 19; else add uniformly 0..remaining capacity
rules.strand: Linked with p, otherwise uniform all 10 including GAS
rules.certificates: Two independent linked p attempts then 0..remaining capacity uniformly from remaining categories
rules.interests: Linked option with p, otherwise uniform four; unlinked questions uniform
rules.skills: Linked high 4 or 5 uniformly with p, otherwise 1..5 uniform; others 1..5 uniform
rules.realized: Final selection fraction per linked item; skillsHigh is final rating >=4, including uniform fallback
